IMG-09_correction.page_sentence: The envelope is the bounding box of the 3D model. The forward-joint screws and two other small parts are not in the 3D model, so they do not show in the renders.
IMG-09_correction.correct_text: The envelope is the bounding box of the 3D model. The 3D model has no standard hardware: none of the 57 hardware lines of the BOM (ENG-HW-101 to ENG-HW-170, 174 items: screws, washers and disc springs, O-rings, seals, dowel pins, thread inserts, clips, a bushing, a fitting and a thread-locker line) is in it, among them the ten forward-joint screws ENG-HW-101 and the disc springs under their heads ENG-HW-170; nor is the transport lock ENG-GM-12 (two half rings, removed before flight). So they do not show in the renders.
